text: Bitcoin is consolidating near record highs with minimal movement, while Ethereum is holding steady and slightly positive—suggesting cautious confidence rather than capitulation or euphoria. The Fear & Greed index at 74 indicates greed sentiment with a week-long uptrend, yet Bitcoin's flat 24h action and elevated dominance at 58.3% point to money rotating toward BTC rather than broad alt rallies. Volume remains robust at $103B, confirming participation despite the sideways price action.
